social.note: Social snapshot: Seychelles has a resident population of about 120,000. The latest NBS National Summary Data Page reports unemployment at 3.2% in Q2 2026.

economic.tag: Tourism, fisheries and an externally connected island economy
economic.strap: Tourism remains a major pillar, while fish products dominate exports and canned tuna is central to the fisheries economy.

economic.note: Economic snapshot: tourism remains an important pillar of the Seychelles economy, while fisheries are unusually important to exports. In 2024, close to 90% of exports were fish products, and 88% of those fish exports were canned tuna.

environment.tag: A small land territory with a vast ocean space
environment.strap: Seychelles combines a tiny terrestrial footprint with a 1.374 million km² ocean territory and extensive land and marine protection.

comparison.title: Seychelles is overwhelmingly an ocean state
comparison.story: The country has only 455.3 km² of land, while its Exclusive Economic Zone covers 1,374,000 km². That contrast helps explain why tourism, fisheries, marine conservation and ocean governance are so important to Seychelles.
